name: glare-hover
blurb: Glare sweep across element on hover using CSS gradient.
description: Wrapper applying a configurable gradient glare effect that sweeps across children on hover. Controls angle, speed, size, and highlight color via CSS variables.
use_when: Cards, tiles, or buttons that need a premium shimmer hover effect without animation libraries.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces or when hover is unavailable.
a11y: Wrapper only; focus and keyboard behavior come from children. Glare is purely visual.
